caption: Trevi Fountain, Rome
composition: Floodlit Baroque fountain at night · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands at the piazza edge facing the Trevi Fountain head on. The floodlit travertine facade fills the frame: Corinthian columns frame the central triumphal arch with its figure above the cascade, a niche and statue to either side. Palazzi with lamplit windows close in on left and right, and the rippling basin spreads across the foreground under the deep 03:42 night.
